title: Canonical universe enlargement of a fixed scheme
statement: Let $u,v$ be universes and let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] in universe $u$. Let $I_X$ be the category whose objects are pairs $(A,a)$ with $A$ a commutative ring in universe $u$ and $a:\operatorname{Spec}A\to X$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], and whose arrows are the commuting triangles between those affine schemes. Define $D_X:I_X\to\mathit{Sch}_{\max(u,v)}$ by $D_X(A,a)=\operatorname{Spec}(\operatorname{ULift}_v A)$ and on arrows by applying Spec to the ring homomorphism transported by ULift. This diagram has a colimit [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], unique up to the canonical colimit isomorphism. The universe enlargement $X^{\uparrow v}$ is this chosen colimit. For another scheme $Y$ in universe $u$ and a morphism $f:X\to Y$, postcomposition of affine maps gives $I_X\to I_Y$ and hence a canonical map $f^{\uparrow v}:X^{\uparrow v}\to Y^{\uparrow v}$, characterized by sending the leg indexed by $(A,a)$ to the leg indexed by $(A,f\circ a)$. These maps respect composition. Thus the construction uses a fixed input scheme in universe $u$ and produces a scheme in $\max(u,v)$ on which larger geometric fields can be tested; it is the usual scheme obtained by enlarging its affine coordinate rings along the ring equivalences $\operatorname{ULift}_v A\simeq A$.

source.place: Section glueing-schemes (Tag 01JA), lemma-glue (Tag 01JB) and lemma-glue-schemes (Tag 01JC): transport the affine gluing construction along ULift.ringEquiv. Auxiliary universe transport for the geometric fibres in Temkin, Stable modification, proof of Theorem 1.1.

proof.text: The existence assertion remains the explicit affine-gluing construction recorded in the theorem docstring; it is not discharged in this delivery.

For composition, apply the colimit hom-extensionality criterion. At each affine index, unfold the two colimit desc maps. The two indexing objects are related by the CostructuredArrow morphism induced by the identity on the source affine scheme; its image under the lifted diagram is an identity by functoriality. The colimit cocone equation then identifies the two legs.

proof_origin: Stage 3 partial proof: composition follows from Mathlib colimit.hom_ext, colimit.w and CostructuredArrow.homMk; the affine gluing existence proof remains open.
